from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeItem(BaseModel):
    """A single fair value change gains/losses line item from one financial report."""
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written in the report (e.g. '公允价值变动收益', '公允价值变动损益')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount; negative indicates loss, positive indicates gain")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the amount covers (e.g. '2024年第一季度')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")
    category: str | None = Field(description="Where this item appears (e.g. '合并利润表', '非经常性损益项目表')")

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/bond security code if provided")
    fair_value_changes: list[FairValueChangeItem] = Field(description="All fair value change related line items found in this report")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial report (e.g. '2024年第一季度财务报告')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
